topThreats.title: Turla hackers use new Cereal malware to spy on govt Exchange servers
topThreats.summary: The Russian state-backed threat group Turla has been using a new malicious toolset called 'Cereal' to intercept emails on Microsoft Exchange servers at government organizations. [...]
topThreats.remediation: Board/Executive: Mandate immediate emergency asset sweep for exposed interfaces. Task Execution: Apply vendor patch or emergency WAF virtual patch, audit access logs for IOCs, and restrict management ports.

topThreats.title: Google patches eighth Chrome zero-day exploited in attacks this year
topThreats.summary: Google has released emergency security updates to patch a new Chrome vulnerability exploited in zero-day attacks, the eighth such flaw since the start of the year. [...]
topThreats.remediation: Board/Executive: Evaluate organizational exposure against NIST CSF 2.0 governance metrics. Task Execution: Verify endpoint telemetry in SIEM, apply vendor security mitigations, and cross-reference internal asset databases.
